title.value: F AITH D IAL : A Faithful Benchmark for Information-Seeking Dialogue
title.justification: The paper focuses on creating a benchmark for evaluating information-seeking dialogues to ensure responses are grounded in factual knowledge, hence the emphasis on 'Faithful' in the title.
title.quote: create F AITH D IAL , a new benchmark for hallucination-free dialogues, by editing hallucinated responses in the Wizard of Wikipedia (W O W) benchmark.

extractions.description: The paper introduces F AITH D IAL, a benchmark designed to produce hallucination-free knowledge-grounded dialogues. It addresses the issue of unsupported utterances in dialogue systems by editing previously hallucinated responses to make them faithful to corresponding knowledge. F AITH D IAL is shown to improve dialogue generation quality in several metrics and is adaptable across different datasets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development is not a theme of this paper. Instead, it focuses on improving dialogue systems in terms of information fidelity and support for reliable virtual assistants.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Ensuring that models are trustworthy is key to deploying them safely in real-world appli-cations, especially in high-stake domains.

primary_category.quote: Unfortunately, modeling solutions alone cannot remedy the hallucination problem. By mimicking the distributional properties of the data, models are bound to ‘parrot’ the hallucinated signals at test time.
